name: r1_abs
change: MLP predicts log trip energy directly (physics integrals only as inputs); RoadSim physics v2, raw simulated energy

name: r2_corr
change: predict a correction to the generic road-load physics estimate

name: r3_lab
change: RoadSim's OBD label model (roadsim.obd.label_fuel: MAF fuel-cut air, missed enrichment) for MAF-estimated fuel; flag input

name: r4_rw
change: v1's dev-fitted on-road loads wrapper on top of v2 (v2 already carries its own on-road load)

name: r5_phev
change: v1's plug-in hardware patch on the generated plug-ins (pack power >= 1.2 x motor, resistance / 2.5, MG2 torque x 1.8); dev twin read: the network put the dev plug-ins 33% above their own RoadSim twins

name: r5b_labphev
change: both near-misses together: RoadSim's OBD label model (r3) and the plug-in patch (r5), each of which improved D2 by just under 0.01 alone

name: r6_ens
change: ensemble of 5 networks (seeds); sigma includes their spread

name: r7_era
change: model-year input (VED: fueleconomy.gov models matched to the car; EPA: test year); the fleet's engine efficiency follows the fueleconomy.gov dev era trend, so the network can tell a 2006 car from a 2022 one

name: r8_epahyb
change: EPA test-car hybrids told their hybrid system (P2 / power-split / series, from the model line; RoadSim's public spec-sheet table) instead of 'power-split' for all; the same networks

name: r9_bus
change: ZTBus told the trolleybus's published curb mass (19 t, 'reported' mass) instead of the class prior (15 t); the same networks

name: r9b_inputs
change: both public-spec inputs together (r8 EPA hybrid system + r9 bus curb mass), each short of the margin alone

name: r10_epalab
change: simulated window-sticker labels by RoadSim's EPA procedure emulation (FTP-75 with hot soak, hybrids preconditioned and corrected for net battery energy) instead of fleet.py's shortcut; physics rung (labels change)

name: r11_big
change: GPU: twice the simulated data (a second bank of 28,800 trips on the same fleet, new seed), wider networks (512 units, 0.73M weights each) and 100 epochs
